name: agent-teams
description: DRI-led agent teams: the /dri playbook, four role agents, a global learning workspace and initiative registry. Hard-requires beads (bd).

use_advisors.title: Use advisors
use_advisors.description: When enabled, background DRI sessions run on sonnet with an advisor attached (--model sonnet --advisor <dri_model>) instead of the default <dri_model>-only session. The advisor's model comes from the dri_model option.

dri_model.title: DRI model
dri_model.description: The 'strong model' slot: when advisors are enabled, this is the advisor's model (the DRI session worker stays sonnet); when advisors are disabled, this is the DRI session's own model. Defaults to "opus[1m]": DRI sessions request a 500k auto-compact window, and the CLI clamps that to the model's real context window, so a sub-1M model here pins compaction back to ~167k tokens no matter what is requested. Setting a non-1M model is supported but re-introduces that clamp.
